done_when: The skill (src/forge/templates/skill.md and its synced copies) says: workers change files outside Scope that the change needs and name them, so the coordinator answers a Scope question only when the change isn't needed; the intent table has rows for naming a fix (--slug) and changing a fix's Done-when (forge fix amend); mark generated files such as migration snapshots linguist-generated in .gitattributes so reviews show them only as counts; and a story's Tests column names one end-to-end case per Done-when item that changes runtime behaviour, with none for settings, docs, deletions or test-only items.
why: The coordinator skill that client repos get lags the last two days of Forge changes, so agents in client repos don't use them: it still says to settle every outside-Scope question before answering a worker, and never mentions naming or amending fixes, marking generated files, or the new test balance
